#### Project

*MODELS OF RESIDUAL STRESSES AND DISTORTIONS IN PIPE WELDING, CONSIDERING MISALIGNED JOINTS*

The project uses the finite-element software Simufact.welding to model the
residual stresses and strains during the welding of pipeline, especially considering the case when
the joint is not perfect, but misaligned. This is a project of much industrial interest because of its
direct and very important implications for pipeline integrity.
